title: Putrefied Tumour
summary: Extract three tumours to make Vitriol of Putrefied Tumour.

fields.Alchemy: Extract 3 Putrefied Tumours into Vitriol of Putrefied Tumour. Combine it with any Sublimate to make Oil of Bane.
fields.Acquisition: Carried by creatures in the Shadow-Cursed Lands.

changes: Added native BG3 rules using pinned item and linked gameplay sources.
